verdict.rationale: The getting-started docs give a ready-to-run prebuilt Docker image (`docker run ... localai/localai:latest`), so developers can install without compiling. The docs also describe LocalAI as "one binary" and say it downloads the right prebuilt GPU backend for the detected hardware. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of downloadable prebuilt binaries per OS/arch, native package-manager installs (e.g., brew/apt/installer script), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the install experience.
